numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Evaluating int() on the symbolic expression a(n) = int(2**n*log(phi)/log(10) - Rational(1,2)*log(5)/log(10)) + 1 blocks (hangs) for n=857 and for other n values such as 1025, 1254, 1466, 1499, 1839, 1905, 1940, 1974, 2069, 2397, 2998, 3092, even though a(10000) computes quickly. The hang occurs when calculating a(857) directly, independent of previously computed values.

The passages do not give the exact expected integer value for a(857) in the form of a test assertion beyond the 258-digit value quoted in the regression test description.
